{{Top|leg}}
The '''mobile stockade''' was a portable containment device utilizing [[Force field/Legends|force fields]] generated from a control box outside of the stockade to hold prisoners. The primary force field was a hemispherical dome projected on the ground, which could be split into two containment areas, or further subdivided into four. In addition to regulating the main power and force field subdivisions, the mobile stockade's control panel could adjust the overall intensity of the field with a dial scaled from one to eleven; without a key, the field could not be lowered in intensity past level two. Other dials on the panel adjusted the individual intensities of the stockade's force field subdivisions.

[[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] and his [[Human League]] troops used a mobile stockade to contain [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], and [[Anakin Solo]], in addition to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Ebrihim]], and [[Marcha]], during the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]]. After enlisting the help of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Q9-X2]] via a hidden [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], who set the field to the lowest settings allowed without a master key, Anakin and the [[Solo twins]] were able to slowly push their way through the field and escape.
